basic_details.job_title: AMU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.post_name: Assistant Professor (Reserved Under 'OH' Category of PwD)
basic_details.short_information: Aligarh Muslim University (AMU), Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for the post of Assistant Professor (Reserved Under 'OH' Category of PwD) under Advt No. FM/44/2026. Applications are accepted online until 18 November 2026.

application_fee.pwd_fee: Exempted from Processing Fee on uploading an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma

qualification.education_qualification: As per NMC norms, adopted by AMU. Open only to PwD candidates of the OH (locomotor disability) category with at least 40% disability.
qualification.details: Qualification: As per NMC norms, adopted by AMU; Degree of relevant disability to a minimum extent of 40%, with Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) | Other conditions: | Post reserved under 'OH' category of PwD Open to Indian nationals including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955

how_to_apply: Fill the application form only in Online Mode at the Careers Portal https://careers.amuonline.ac.in by 18.11.2026 (11:59 P.M.).
Upload the Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) with the online form.
Take a printout of the PDF of the application form on A-4 size paper, sign it and paste a recent front-facing photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents.
Send the hard copy by post, writing post applied for, advertisement number and date on top-left of the cover.
Hard copy must reach the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh-202002 by 26.11.2026 (04:00 p.m.).
important_instructions: No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued to the candidates Separate application forms for each post under a different serial number Qualifications, experience and other eligibility reckoned as on last date of submission of application form Amendment/Corrigendum, if any, published only on the Careers Portal Number and nature of posts may vary at the time of interview Help Desk: +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178) on working days during office hours

content_sections.heading: AMU Assistant Professor (Reserved Under 'OH' Category of PwD) Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.aligarh_muslim_university_amu_uttar_prad: Assistant Professor (Reserved Under 'OH' Category of PwD)
Department of Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh
As per NMC norms, adopted by AMU. Open only to PwD candidates of the OH (locomotor disability) category with at least 40% disability.

content_sections.heading: AMU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. FM/44/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AMU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: As per NMC norms, adopted by AMU; Degree of relevant disability to a minimum extent of 40%, with Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) Other conditions: Post reserved under 'OH' category of PwD Open to Indian nationals including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AMU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates without originals of all documents at interview will not be allowed to appear Applications received late or without supporting documents will be summarily rejected Incomplete application forms or applications on plain paper will be summarily rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on purely temporary basis, subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason

rows.application_fee: Exempted from Processing Fee on uploading an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma

rows.event: Last date for receipt of Online Application Forms (upto 11:59 P.M.)
Last date for receipt of hard copy of online application (by 04:00 p.m.)
Local Selection Committee (12:30 p.m.; reporting 12:00 noon)

content_sections.heading: How Will AMU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny and possible short-listing of applications Local Selection Committee (interview) with presentation Verification of original documents Medical examination of selected applicant by University Medical Board Local Selection Committee on 03.12.2026 at 12:30 p.m. in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine; reporting 12:00 noon Candidates bring one presentation on their area of interest in their concerned subject in soft copy (pen drive) University may restrict number called for interview and short-list applications Disability claim examined by University Medical Board before appointment letter

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of all marksheets, certificates and degrees from class Xth to postgraduation Internship completion certificate Valid registration of Graduation and Post graduation from NMC Experience certificate and NOC from present employer if employed, or relieving orders of previous employers Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be; M. Phil/Ph.D. degree wherever applicable Disability Certificate on prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I)

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued to the candidates Separate application forms for each post under a different serial number Qualifications, experience and other eligibility reckoned as on last date of submission of application form Amendment/Corrigendum, if any, published only on the Careers Portal Number and nature of posts may vary at the time of interview Help Desk: +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178) on working days during office hours

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Professor (Reserved Under 'OH' Category of PwD).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PwD: Exempted from Processing Fee on uploading an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level AL-10.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per NMC norms, adopted by AMU. Open only to PwD candidates of the OH (locomotor disability) category with at least 40% disability.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Post reserved under 'OH' category of PwD. Open to Indian nationals including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without originals of all documents at interview will not be allowed to appear. Applications received late or without supporting documents will be summarily rejected. Incomplete application forms or applications on plain paper will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and possible short-listing of applications. Local Selection Committee (interview) with presentation. Verification of original documents. Medical examination of selected applicant by University Medical Board.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on purely temporary basis, subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.
